info.name: Complify Chat API
info.description:
Standards upload (Part 1 / Part 2 parent-child, local storage) + ChatGPT-style report evaluation chat.

Set base_url and user_id in collection variables. Run folders in order: 1 → 2 → 3. IDs (part1_id, part2_id, chat_id, report_id) are saved automatically by test scripts.

For file fields: select the PDF in each request's Body tab (Postman does not store file paths in exported collections).

request.description: Server, storage backend, model check.

item.name: 1. Standards
item.description: Standard PDFs are stored locally in storage/standards/{FAMILY}/part1|part2|other/. Part 2 links itself to its Part 1 parent.

request.description: Part 1 = general requirements (parent). name/edition are auto-detected from the PDF if left empty.
Part 2 = particular requirements (child). If Part 1 is already uploaded, the parent is linked; otherwise you get a warning and the link happens automatically when Part 1 arrives.
Use this when auto-detection gets the name/edition wrong (scanned PDFs, odd cover pages).
